import {
  Box,
  FormControl,
  MenuItem,
  Select,
  Stack,
  Typography,
  Chip,
  Button,
} from "@mui/material";

import RefreshRoundedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/RefreshRounded";
import DownloadRoundedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/DownloadRounded";
import CompareArrowsRoundedIcon from "@mui/icons-material/CompareArrowsRounded";

const ForecastContextBar = () => {
  return (
    <Box
      sx={{
        position: "sticky",
        top: 0,
        zIndex: 100,
        bgcolor: "background.paper",
        borderRadius: 4,
        border: "1px solid",
        borderColor: "divider",
        p: 3,
        mb: 4,
      }}
    >
      <Stack spacing={3}>
        <Stack
          direction="row"
          justifyContent="space-between"
          alignItems="center"
          flexWrap="wrap"
          gap={2}
        >
          <Typography
            variant="h5"
            fontWeight={700}
          >
            Forecast Context
          </Typography>

          <Stack direction="row" spacing={2}>

            <Button
              variant="contained"
              startIcon={<DownloadRoundedIcon />}
            >
              Export
            </Button>
          </Stack>
        </Stack>

        <Stack
          direction={{
            xs: "column",
            lg: "row",
          }}
          spacing={3}
        >
          <FormControl fullWidth>
            <Typography
              variant="overline"
              fontWeight={700}
            >
              Horizon
            </Typography>

            <Select defaultValue="daily">
              <MenuItem value="daily">
                Tactical (Daily - 90 Days)
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="monthly">
                Strategic (Monthly - 36 Months)
              </MenuItem>
            </Select>
          </FormControl>

          <FormControl fullWidth>
            <Typography
              variant="overline"
              fontWeight={700}
            >
              Metric
            </Typography>

            <Select defaultValue="burn">
              <MenuItem value="burn">
                Burn Predictions
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="supply">
                Supply Predictions
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="stockpile">
                Stockpile
              </MenuItem>
            </Select>
          </FormControl>

          <FormControl fullWidth>
            <Typography
              variant="overline"
              fontWeight={700}
            >
              Power Station
            </Typography>

            <Select defaultValue="arnot">
              <MenuItem value="arnot">Arnot</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="kendal">Kendal</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="matimba">Matimba</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="tutuka">Tutuka</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="kusile">Kusile</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="medupi">Medupi</MenuItem>
              <MenuItem value="all">
                Total Fleet
              </MenuItem>
            </Select>
          </FormControl>

          <FormControl fullWidth>
            <Typography
              variant="overline"
              fontWeight={700}
            >
              Scenario
            </Typography>

            <Select defaultValue="actual">
              <MenuItem value="actual">
                Actual (Baseline)
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="hotdry">
                Hot & Dry
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="hotwet">
                Hot & Wet
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="colddry">
                Cold & Dry
              </MenuItem>

              <MenuItem value="coldwet">
                Cold & Wet
              </MenuItem>
            </Select>
          </FormControl>
        </Stack>

      </Stack>
    </Box>
  );
};

export default ForecastContextBar;
